title: Titanium dioxide (TiO2)
method: Lunar Prospector GRS Ti abundance (2° bins on the 0.5° grid) converted to TiO2 with the molar-mass ratio 1.6683. Bilinear resampling of the 0.5° simple-cylindrical product (longitude wraps at ±180°). True footprint ~60–150 km: finer grids add no detail.

sources.name: Lunar Prospector GRS/NS special products (0.5°)
